rows.label: tlk70000038_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Those black things wrecked so much
that Popolo was sad, mo. The shopping
ward is like Popolo's home, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000038_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Then everyone in the shopping ward
cheered me up and helped out, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000038_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Thanks to them, the town is almost
back to normal, and Popolo has
recovered too, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000038_02_msg0004
rows.name:
But... I'm still worried about
Chairman Morumo, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000038_02_msg0005
rows.name:
He's been so busy that fur is falling
out all over, mo. At this rate he'll
be completely bald, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000038_02_msg0006
rows.name:
Ahh... But now I kind of want to see
Chairman Morumo like that, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000038_02_msg0007
rows.name: It might suit him surprisingly well...

rows.label: tlk70000038_02_msg0008
rows.name:
Sorry, mo. I must have been spacing
out, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000038_02_msg0009
rows.name:
Anyway, now it's Popolo's turn to work
hard, mo! Popolo will protect both the
shopping ward and his fur, mo!!
